speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Digital technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly reshaping jobs and industries.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: As AI tools become more accessible, MDDI will help enterprises, including small and medium-sized enterprises, deploy them to improve efficiency.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will engage the Labour Movement, professional bodies, trade associations and chambers to develop suitable programmes to equip our workers with AI-related skills, and grow a core of AI-fluent workers who can be pacesetters in their fields.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also work across the Government, with industry and the community to achieve scale in outreach.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MDDI will continue to support individuals and households in accessing digital tools and services, and work with partners to promote inclusivity of digital services by design.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also transform our libraries and archives to encourage reading, learning and discovery through offering physical and digital resources for all.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MDDI will help Singaporeans stay safe online amid rising scams, cyberbullying and increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: To promote healthier digital interactions for children and youth, we will study interventions in other countries, build on existing measures for age-appropriate access and encourage positive norms for digital well-being.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Public Service Media (PSM) and Government platforms remain essential for informed discourse that upholds public trust and social cohesion.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MDDI will continue to support PSM entities by ensuring their financial sustainability, strengthening their verification capabilities, improving the prominence and discoverability of their products, and enhancing their ability to share Singapore’s perspectives internationally.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MDDI will strengthen government communications across online and offline channels, ensuring their content remains timely, trusted and relevant to citizens.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through Reaching Everyone for Active Citizenry @ Home (REACH), we will deepen engagement and foster trust by bringing together people with diverse viewpoints.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: To meet growing demand for cybersecurity expertise, we will develop talent, innovation and the local research and development ecosystem.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Resilient and future-ready infrastructure is essential for Singapore to thrive in a complex digital environment.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MDDI will lead whole-of-Government efforts to transform our digital systems and deliver more user-centric, secure and resilient digital services.

speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: This will be supported by plans to systematically improve the Public Service’s digital capabilities, including through scaling up training for public officers.
